newsitem.title: USA: Texas power prices steady to lower in mild weather.
newsitem.headline: Texas power prices steady to lower in mild weather.

text.p: Wholesale power prices in Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) were steady to lower Tuesday with mild weather through much of the state limiting demand, brokers and marketers said.

Temperatures in the southern half of Texas were expected to reach highs in the mid to high 70s degrees Fahrenheit Tuesday, with longer term forecasts calling for above-average temperatures from Nov 17 to 21.

Also, Texas Utilities said its 1,150 megawatt Commanche Peak nuclear power unit 1 was likely to synchronize to the electricity grid this weekend, returning from a scheduled refueling and maintenance outage which began Oct 5.
Prices for peak, firm power for Wednesday delivery were talked at $25.50-26.50 for a 16-hour package from discussion in a range of $26.00-27.00 on Monday, the sources said.
Off-peak ERCOT power was seen steady at $13.00-15.00.
December peak power was talked steady at $24.25-24.75, while January/February ERCOT power prices held in the $24.50-25.50 range, the sources said.
